# `input_file_name`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the name of the file being read, or empty string if not available.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
input_file_name()
```
